name: Survey tile in Capricornus
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.6 degrees north of the ecliptic in Capricornus, imaged by SPHEREx 19 times in 8 visits over 78 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 46 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 3.3 days starting 2026-04-23, at wavelengths from 0.76 to 4.67 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
